Pins 1=VIN to VOUT_5V, 2=GND to B0, 3=high-active EN to PA15/FAN_RUN, 4=open-drain nFAULT intentionally NC, 5=ILIM to R_FAN_ILIM=6.8kΩ 1% to B0, 6=VOUT to FAN_5V. Datasheet limit at 6.8kΩ: 915mA min, 1010mA typ, 1088mA max; including 1% set resistor estimate 906mA..1.10A. VOUT_5V powers this switch; No separate downstream fuse. Exact symbol/footprint library association still needs review. 2A熔丝在本开关正常限流上限约1.10A下无动作窗口，故删除F_FAN/FH_FAN。SGM2593限流、短路降额、热保护与默认关闭保留；开关击穿绕过限流时，主5V buck的板级短路响应仍待首板确认，未声称单故障已经验收。
SN74LVC1G11DCKR pin map 1=A,2=GND,3=B,4=Y,5=VCC,6=C. PRECHARGE_WINDOW=SW_RUN & BMS_LOCAL_OK & TMR_ACTIVE; this bounds the external QPRE path to the one-shot window and local run permit.

Vishay VO617A-2X007T SMD-4 option 7; manufacturer pinout 1=LED A, 2=LED K, 3=phototransistor E, 4=C. Pins 3/4 are a floating external-side positive-logic EN switch: pin4 takes the receiving system's low-current, precharge-available EN bias through its current-limiting resistor; pin3 drives the common LOAD_POWER_VALID EN bus. All receiver ENs must default low with pull-downs to their own PACK-side return. Keep both output pins isolated from B0/CORE_3V3 and use signal-level current only; verify CTR/temperature margin in external design.
DBV pins1 GND,2 active-low push-pull RESET,3 VDD; 2.93V threshold option. No reset pull-up is required.

Silicon Content SCT2A26STER, asynchronous buck, 5V output, 2A rated / 4A peak current limit. Pin map: 1 GND=B0, 2 VIN=CELL_B9 raw pack positive, 3 EN=PSU_EN, 4 NC, 5 FB=PSU_FB, 6 TM=B0, 7 BST=PSU_BST, 8 SW=PSU_SW, 9 EP=B0. Datasheet 5V application values: 33uH, 95k/30k feedback, 68pF feed-forward; use 95.3k/30.1k for nominal ~5.0V. Operating input design range is 22.5–37.8V at CELL_B9; absolute VIN limit is 100V, not a validated transient allowance. Switching, thermal, input-capacitance derating, and board-level checks remain open. Exact IC symbol/footprint package mapping pending native-library verification.

SN74LVC74ADR pin mapping unchanged. FF-A: D1=1, CLK1=MAIN_REQ, /PRE1=1, /CLR1=MAIN_CLR_N=BQ_ALERT_IC_N & BMS_LOCAL_OK, Q1=FET_RELEASE. Fault/permit low asynchronously clears main and LOAD_POWER_VALID; recovery needs a fresh MAIN_REQ edge. MCU alone checks precharge voltage and timer completion before requesting main; no independent hardware PRE_OK interlock remains. FF-B: D2=1, CLK2=PRE_REQ, /PRE2=1, /CLR2=POR_OK_N, Q2=TMR_TRIG; one attempt per powered session, only physical OFF/POR rearms. TPL5111 one-shot timing window and U_GATE1 remain. Firmware requires physical OFF after faults, never automatic reclose. ALERT Pin Config 0x92FC=0x82；Default Alarm Mask 0x926D和运行时AlarmEnable 0x66均屏蔽XCHG bit6/XDSG bit5，避免BOTHOFF启动时死锁。保留SSBC bit15、SSA bit14、PF bit13及需要清锁存的真实保护告警；逐项映射OV/UV/OC/SCD/温度及HWDF，读回配置。若此前选中过6/5，先禁用再清旧锁存并确认ALERT解除；真实保护原因须先记录再按恢复策略清除。HWD有限延时；0x9263/0x9267/0x926B bit1启用保护及CHG/DSG动作。DFETOFF 0x92FB=0x42，FET Options 0x9308=0x2D。参考TI TRM https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/sluuby2b/sluuby2b.pdf

TI TPL5111DDCR；DDC/SOT-23-6：1=VDD，2=GND，3=DELAY/M_DRV，4=DONE，5=DRVn，6=EN/ONE_SHOT。本图TMR_SET接7.32kΩ至B0；DONE与EN/ONE_SHOT固定B0，使用one-shot。FF-B Q经R_TIMER_SUPPLY=1kΩ给TMR_VDD供电，FF-B只在PRE_CTRL掉电/POR时复位，MCU不能重触发；DRVn输出TMR_ACTIVE，经U_GATE1与SW_RUN、BMS_LOCAL_OK形成PRECHARGE_WINDOW。复用C_TIMER=100nF跨TMR_VDD-B0。标称tIP≈2.578s、输出高脉冲≈2.528s；FF-Q至关断保守纸面估计约2.87s，适用角落按PRE_CTRL=3.0–3.6V、−40..85°C。温漂取厂商设计最大参数，不是逐颗测试；数据手册未列Ioff，不作Ioff保证。大陆单件价参考DigiKey中国¥10.82（含13%税、MOQ1、Cut Tape）；Digi-Reel另收¥49。采购前刷新库存/报价。资料：https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpl5111.pdf；报价：https://www.digikey.cn/en/products/detail/texas-instruments/TPL5111DDCR/6572460?s=N4Ig7CBcoIYE5QIwA5EGYA0IYBcmZAAcBLKANjDTTAAYBfOoA
